description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ClientCollateralNotFoundException' used in the collateral management component of the Fineract project, indicating that a specific client collateral resource was not found.

classes.name: ClientCollateralNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' to signal that a specific collateral resource for a client was not found based on the provided ID.

methods.name: ClientCollateralNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific message indicating the collateral with the given ID does not exist.

calls: super("error.msg.client.collateral.id.invalid", "Collateral with identifier " + id + " does not exist", id)
